subtopic: Reference Circle, Phase and Graphical Representation
stem:
The graph shows variation of displacement of a particle performing S.H.M. with time \(t\). Which of the following statements is correct from the graph?

[Graph: displacement \(x\) is plotted on the vertical axis against time \(t\) on the horizontal axis. The curve is a sine curve starting at \(x = 0\) when \(t = 0\): it rises to its positive extreme at \(t = T/4\), returns to \(x = 0\) at \(t = T/2\), falls to its negative extreme at \(t = 3T/4\), returns to \(x = 0\) at \(t = T\), and then repeats, reaching its positive extreme again at \(t = 5T/4\) and \(x = 0\) at \(t = 3T/2\). The instants \(T/4\), \(T/2\), \(3T/4\) and \(T\) are marked on the \(t\)-axis.]

options.label: A
options.text: The acceleration is maximum at time \(T\).

options.label: B
options.text: The force is maximum at time \(3T/4\).

options.label: C
options.text: The velocity is zero at time \(T/2\).

options.label: D
options.text: The kinetic energy is equal to total energy at time \(T/4\).
